automation.description: The automation that caused the event, beside `via`.

name.description: What the automation was called when it acted.

createdAt.description: When the event happened, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

id.description: The event's id. A retry or a redelivery carries the same id, so a receiver can drop one it has already handled.

via.description: `automation` when one of your automations caused the event; absent otherwise.

get.description: One page of the connection's printshop catalogue, each product marked with whether this workspace imported it through that connection and, with `blanks:read`, as which blank.

parameters.description: Only the products filed under this one of the partner's categories (GET /v1/printshop-connections/{id}/categories).
parameters.name: categoryId

schema.description: Only the products filed under this one of the partner's categories (GET /v1/printshop-connections/{id}/categories).

parameters.description: Only the products whose name holds this, ignoring case; blank is no search. `total` then counts the matches.
parameters.name: search

schema.description: Only the products whose name holds this, ignoring case; blank is no search. `total` then counts the matches.

catalogueTotal.description: How many products the whole catalogue holds, whatever the category and the search; null when the partner did not say or the count could not be read.

categoryId.description: The partner category the product is filed under, which an import maps onto the workspace's blank categories; null when it names none.

holds.description: What the product holds: how many colours, sizes and variants it is sold in; each null when the partner did not say.

importedBlankId.description: The blank it was imported as through this connection, the latest when there are several; null when it has not been.

searchComplete.description: False when a search stopped before the end of the catalogue it searches, so `total` counts the matches among the products it read only. True with no search.

searchedProducts.description: How many products an incomplete search read, from the first; null when the search was complete or there was none.

total.description: How many products answer the query (the category and the search), across every page; null when the partner did not say.

200.description: A page of the partner's products

feature.description: The feature the tenant does not have. Always sent with `feature_disabled`.

500.description: Refused: lookup_failed, db_error. A request that failed unexpectedly answers as text instead.

post.description: Writes the blank at once, `importing`, and answers with it and the job that fills in its variants and photos in the background, 202. The blank becomes `ready` when the job ends, or `failed` with `importFailure` saying why. An integration key is answered the blank already imported from the product through the connection, 200, when there is one that has not failed; the body may be empty. A failed import's blank keeps its name until a member removes it, so importing the product again under that name is refused `409 duplicate_name`.

colours.description: The colours to fetch photos of, by name as the options read answers them; absent for every colour. A colour named here that the product does not have is ignored.

name.description: As the library shows it. Omitted, the printshop's product name.

printshopPhotos.description: Whether the printshop's photos are fetched as the blank's catalogue photos. True is refused where the printshop has no photo with a print area. Omitted, they are fetched if it has any.

sceneIds.description: Stock photos, the scenes in the order they show, first in the blank's order and before the printshop's photos. They may photograph several stock items, each scene its own. On each of them, each placement with a role that item has a place for takes its default record; one with none shows on none of its scenes.

views.description: The views to fetch photos for, by the key the options read answers; absent for every view.

areasVaryBy.description: The options the blank's print areas change with, such as Size, in option order; empty for one print area per placement. Each placement's `areas` names a row of these.

axes.description: The blank's option axes, such as Color and Size, in the order the shopper sees them. Empty for a blank with one variant.

boundProduct.description: The partner's product a bound blank (`partnerLocked`) is bound to, or null for a blank bound to none. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

id.description: The partner's own id of the product.

name.description: The product's name as the printshop last reported it: at import, then at each check for printshop changes. Null when the record of the import is gone.

copiedFrom.description: The blank this one was copied to its printshop from, or null.

blankId.description: The source blank's id, which may since have been deleted.

name.description: The source blank's name when it was copied.

deleted.description: When and by whom the blank was deleted, or null for a blank that is not. A deleted blank is read-only: restore it to change it.

at.description: When the blank was deleted, epoch ms.

by.description: The member who deleted it; null when a key did.

name.description: The member's name as it is now; null once unknown.

generation.description: The draw a blank generated with AI waits on while it is `generating`, or while it is `importing` the catalogue product it is made as; null for any other blank.

decision.description: Where the draw's purchase stands, as the draw reads it.

drawId.description: The draw of its photo: read, approve, deny or redraw it at `/v1/pixel/blank-photos/{id}`. Approving writes the photo into the blank and makes it `ready`; denying removes the blank.

photoAssetId.description: The photo the draw drew for its first view drawn, in the library, to show while it waits to be decided; null before one is drawn.

importFailure.description: The code a failed import failed with, such as `partner_failed` or `storage_quota_exceeded`; null unless `status` is `failed`.

options.description: The blank's options with their values, in the order the shopper sees them, a value no variant uses yet included. `axes` is their names.

oneOf.description: The value is drawn in one or two flat colours.

colours.description: One `#rrggbb` colour, or two for a heather or two-tone, drawn half and half.

tone.description: Whether a product in this value is light or dark, set by you. Absent, a colour fill's first colour decides (darker than mid grey is dark) and any other value is light. A template layer's on-dark value is used on a dark one.

oneOf.description: The value is drawn as a picture of it, such as a pattern.

assetId.description: An image in the workspace's asset library.

tone.description: Whether a product in this value is light or dark, set by you. Absent, a colour fill's first colour decides (darker than mid grey is dark) and any other value is light. A template layer's on-dark value is used on a dark one.

appearances.description: How each value looks to a shopper, by value: a colour fill, an image, or null for none. Every value of `values` is named.

localizedNames.description: The option's name per customer-facing language, by code: only the languages it has one in. A language left out reads `name`.

localizedValues.description: Each value's name per customer-facing language, by value: only the values that have one. A language left out reads the value itself.

tones.description: Whether a product in each value is light or dark, by value: the tone set on its appearance, else its colour fill's, else light. Every value of `values` is named. On a variant of a dark value a template's on-dark values are used.

optionsConfirmedAt.description: When the blank's options were confirmed: the merchant said it has one version, or added its first option. Null until then. A blank imported from a printshop's catalogue arrives confirmed.

order.description: The blank's stored views and the scenes it shows as one ordered list, each saying its source: `stock` (a scene), `catalogue` (the printshop's photos) or `own` (the merchant's). The first with a photo is the blank's picture. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

source.description: `catalogue` for the printshop's photos, `own` for the merchant's.

row.description: The option values the stock photo shows, by option name, of the options the blank's photos change with (`photosVaryBy`): shoppers see it only for the variants with these values. Absent or empty: every variant.

source.description: A scene from the library.

orderCount.description: How many orders name the blank, past ones included. Answered in a list, never for one blank, and only to a caller with `orders:read`.

paintBy.description: The option the blank's dyed photos are painted in, such as Colour: a stock photo that takes a dye, or a view drawn from a 3D render, shows each variant in its value's colour. null: the merchant's own photos show as photographed, while a stock photo that takes a dye is painted in the first option with colours.

photoCoverage.description: How much of the blank is photographed. Answered in a list.

cells.description: The blank's rows (each combination of the values of the options its photos change with; one for All) times its views.

filled.description: The cells with a photo, of their own row or a covering one.

photosVaryBy.description: The options the blank's photos change with, in option order: each photo belongs to one row, its values of these, and shows every variant with them. Empty is All: one photo per view shows every variant.

placements.description: The blank's placements: the areas a design is printed into. An update replaces the whole list, so send every placement to keep.

areas.description: The placement's print area per row of the blank's `areasVaryBy` options, such as one per size; omitted or empty, the placement has one print area, its own. maxWidthMm and maxHeightMm are then the widest and tallest row.

bleedMm.description: Bleed past the trim on the row, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, the placement's.

dpi.description: Print resolution on the row in dots per inch. Omitted, the placement's.

foldMm.description: How far in from the trim the product folds on the row, in millimetres. Omitted, the placement's.

heightMm.description: The tallest print the row takes, in millimetres.

row.description: The row: a value for each `areasVaryBy` option, by option name. One area per row per placement.

safeAreaMm.description: Safe area inside the trim on the row, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, the placement's.

shape.description: Where on the product a print may go on the row, such as one phone model's camera opening: as the placement's `shape`, in fractions of the row's print area. Omitted, the placement's.

cutByPrintShop.description: True when the print shop cuts the product to this shape: the outline and the cut-outs go into the print file as its cut line. Omitted, the product already has the shape.

dFrac.description: The shape as SVG path data in fractions of the print area, 0 to 1 across and down (curves, no arcs): its first subpath the outline, every further one a cut-out, filled even-odd, each subpath closed.

usualHeightMm.description: The height a print gets on the row when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most heightMm.

usualWidthMm.description: The width a print gets on the row when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most widthMm.

widthMm.description: The widest print the row takes, in millimetres.

bleedMm.description: Bleed past the trim on each side, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, its category's, else the workspace's.

coverage.description: How a print covers the placement: `within`, a print of any size up to the maximum placed inside it, or `full`, a print that is the whole area, such as an all-over-print panel. Omitted, `within`. A `full` placement's usual size is its area, and a request naming a smaller size is refused `print_size_not_area`.

defaultHeightMm.description: The height a print gets when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most maxHeightMm.

defaultWidthMm.description: The width a print gets when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most maxWidthMm.

dpi.description: Print resolution in dots per inch. Omitted, its category's, else 300.

fillColour.description: The `#rrggbb` colour an optional placement left undesigned is printed or delivered as. Null or omitted for none.

flatLayout.description: How the product is printed flat on one sheet and folded into shape, such as a folding box. Its print area is the sheet, printed edge to edge (`coverage` `full`) at one size. Null or omitted, the placement is printed as it lies.

parts.description: The sheet's parts, each a rectangle in mm from the sheet's top-left. The sheet is their span; a fold is where two parts share an edge, and the cut line is every other edge.

printed.description: True for a panel, named for the face of the folded product it becomes; false for a glue tab, hidden once folded. The print covers glue tabs too.

up.description: Which way is up on the part once folded, in quarter turns clockwise from the sheet's up: 2 for a flap that lies upside down on the sheet.

xMm.description: The part's left edge, in mm from the sheet's left.

yMm.description: The part's top edge, in mm from the sheet's top.

foldMm.description: How far in from the trim the product folds on every side, in millimetres, such as a canvas's wrap round its frame; the designer draws fold lines there. Omitted, no fold.

garments.description: Where the placement sits on each stock item the blank's scenes show, one record per item: the item, a garment area of it, and the print's top left and width on it in millimetres. A scene whose item has no record draws nothing of the placement. Refused `placement_garment_area_unknown` for an unknown item or area, `placement_garment_outside_area` past the area.

area.description: The key of a garment area of the record's stock item.

stockItem.description: The stock item the record is on, by its key.

widthMm.description: The print's width on the product, in mm. Its height follows from the placement's print area ratio.

xMm.description: The print's left edge, in mm from the area's left.

yMm.description: The print's top edge, in mm from the area's top.

id.description: Unique within the blank; a short stable one such as `front`, which a template refers to it by.

linkWith.description: The placement it is linked with by default, such as a right sleeve with the left one: one design then drives both unless a designer link, an SDK mount or a design says otherwise. Null or omitted for none. A placement linked with one no longer on the blank is linked with none.

mirror.description: Whether this placement's print is mirrored left to right when the two are linked.

placementId.description: The id of the blank's other placement it is linked with by default.

maxHeightMm.description: The tallest print the placement takes, in millimetres.

maxWidthMm.description: The widest print the placement takes, in millimetres.

name.description: What it is called, such as Front or Back.

printMethod.description: How this placement is printed, such as dtg or screen. Omitted, its category's.

required.description: Whether an order on the blank must print it: one without a print for it is refused `placement_unfilled`. Omitted is false; a blank bound to its printshop's product takes it from the printshop.

safeAreaMm.description: Safe area inside the trim on each side, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, its category's, else the workspace's.

shape.description: Where on the product a print may go when that is not the whole rectangle: nothing is printed outside the outline or in a cut-out. Null or omitted, the whole rectangle.

cutByPrintShop.description: True when the print shop cuts the product to this shape: the outline and the cut-outs go into the print file as its cut line. Omitted, the product already has the shape.

dFrac.description: The shape as SVG path data in fractions of the print area, 0 to 1 across and down (curves, no arcs): its first subpath the outline, every further one a cut-out, filled even-odd, each subpath closed.

shopName.description: Printed as: the name the blank's printshop knows the placement by, on orders and job sheets. Null or omitted prints the placement's name.

views.description: The ways the placement is photographed, such as Flat or On model. Every photo of one view shares its pixel size and its print area.

fromPrintshop.description: True on a view a blank bound to its printshop's product took from the printshop (its import, Add colours, model photos): its photo size and print area are the printshop's and cannot change by hand. Absent on a view the workspace added; a save that sends it is ignored.

label.description: What it is called, such as Flat or On model; unique among its placement's views of its kind, the printshop's or the merchant's, ignoring case.

localizedLabels.description: What it is called per customer-facing language, by code; a language left out reads `label`. No two views of its placement and kind read the same in one language, ignoring case.

maskAssetId.description: A library asset of the view's photo size: where it is light the print shows, where it is dark the print is hidden, as behind a sleeve or a fold. Absent hides nothing.

mesh.description: Control points the print is laid through or, marked cut, cut to, rows from its top edge and points from its left, as [x, y] in the photo's original pixels; at least 2 and at most 33 along each side. Absent, the print is laid in the rect.

cut.description: The points draw a shape to cut the print to rather than a mesh to bend it through: the print is laid flat over the box the points span, at its own proportions and filling it, and everything outside the shape the outer points draw is cut away. Absent, the print is warped through the mesh.

points.description: The rows of control points, from the print's top edge.

items.description: One row of control points, from the print's left edge.
One control point, [x, y] in the photo's original pixels.

partnerStyleKey.description: The printshop's own key for the photo style the view was made from, such as a model or lifestyle style; absent on a view made by hand or imported with the product.

photoSizePx.description: The pixel size every photo of the view has; null until the view holds a photo.

photos.description: The view's product photos, each the same size as the view.

assetId.description: The photo's asset id, as the assets feature returns it after an upload.

displacementStrength.description: How far the photo's folds move the design, more than 0 and at most 1. null moves nothing. Omitted, its category's, else nothing.

id.description: The photo's id, unique within the blank: the `mockupId` a render and a mockup link name.

row.description: The photo's value of each `photosVaryBy` option; empty when there are none. One photo per row per view.

shadingStrength.description: How strongly the photo's light and shade carry onto the design, 0 (none) to 1 (all). Omitted, its category's, else the default strength.

textureStrength.description: How strongly the photo's fine detail, such as a weave or a grain, shows through the print, 0 (none) to 1 (all). Omitted, its category's, else, as for null, the default strength.

variantRefs.description: The variants the photo shows, from its `row`. A write may name the row by these instead.

warp.description: How the design wraps round the product. null lies it flat. Omitted, its category's, else flat.

curvature.description: How far round the product the design wraps, more than 0 and at most 1. Flat is a null warp, not 0.

edgeFalloff.description: How much the design darkens toward the product's sides, 0 (none) to 1 (black at the edge). Omitted, none.

kind.description: The kind of wrap; `cylinder` is the only one.

piece.description: A pattern piece of the view's UV pass, 1 to 254: the region's print is read through the pixels the pass marks with it, in place of a mesh.

placementRectPx.description: Where the print area sits on every photo of the view, in the original photo's pixels; null until it is marked.

h.description: The print area's height, in pixels.

w.description: The print area's width, in pixels.

x.description: The print area's left edge, in pixels from the photo's left.

y.description: The print area's top edge, in pixels from the photo's top.

position.description: The view's place in the blank's one list of views and scenes, from 0. The first with a photo is the blank's picture. Read only.

printWindowMm.description: The part of the region's piece its print covers, in millimetres on the piece's unwrapped surface from its top-left corner, such as a square on the side of a cup: the print fills it at the window's size, and the product shows plain outside it. It lies inside its piece and needs the piece's size on the view. Absent, the whole piece.

xMm.description: The window's left edge, in mm from the piece's left.

yMm.description: The window's top edge, in mm from the piece's top.

sceneId.description: The scene this view shows. A scene's view is built from the blank's chosen scenes and is read only.

scenePosition.description: On a scene's view, its `position`, for a reader that orders scenes by it.

source.description: Where the view's photos come from: `stock` (a scene from the library), `catalogue` (the printshop's) or `own` (the merchant's). Read only.

sourceWindowMm.description: The piece of the placement's print the region shows, in millimetres from the print's top-left corner, such as a roll's window; clamped to the print when the print is smaller. Absent, the region shows the whole print at the size of the render's variant.

xMm.description: The window's left edge, in mm from the print's left.

yMm.description: The window's top edge, in mm from the print's top.

takesDye.description: On a scene's view, whether a variant's colour recolours it. One that takes none shows only the variants of its colour.

uvPasses.description: The maps the view was rendered with from a 3D model of the product, each the view's photo size; a region naming a piece is drawn through them. Absent, the view's regions are laid in their rect or mesh.

multiplyAssetId.description: The multiply pass: the garment's shadows and folds.

occluderAssetId.description: What lies in front of the print, drawn over it: hands, cords and hair. A scene's alone, and read only.

pieceSizesMm.description: Each piece's print size on the model, as its `view.json` gives it: what a region's print window is placed on. Absent, no region of the view may name a print window.

items.description: A piece of the UV pass and its print's size on the model.

heightMm.description: The piece's print height on the model, in mm.

piece.description: A pattern piece of the view's UV pass, 1 to 254: the region's print is read through the pixels the pass marks with it, in place of a mesh.

widthMm.description: The piece's print width on the model, in mm.

pieces.description: The pieces the UV pass marks, as its `view.json` lists them.

items.description: A pattern piece of the view's UV pass, 1 to 254: the region's print is read through the pixels the pass marks with it, in place of a mesh.

screenAssetId.description: The screen pass: the garment's highlights.

uvAssetId.description: The 16-bit UV pass: for each pixel, its piece (blue) and where across (red) and down (green) that piece's print it reads.

webPhotoAssetId.description: On a scene's view, the photo a browser shows: the lighter file of the same picture.

zoomTier.description: On a scene's view read at its preview tier, its files at the zoom tier.

maskAssetId.description: The file saying where on the picture a print may show.

multiplyAssetId.description: The shading laid over the print, darkening it.

occluderAssetId.description: What lies in front of the print, on a scene that has it.

photoAssetId.description: The scene's picture at this tier.

photoSizePx.description: How many pixels the scene's picture holds at this tier.

heightPx.description: The picture's height at this tier, in pixels.

widthPx.description: The picture's width at this tier, in pixels.

screenAssetId.description: The highlights laid over the print, lightening it.

uvAssetId.description: The file saying where each pixel lands on the print.

placementsAtOtherSize.description: The placements printed as a position that prints one size only at the blank's printshop whose default print size is another size: flagged, never refused, since an order of the position's size is still taken. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

position.description: The printshop's position the placement is printed as.

sizeMm.description: The one size that position prints, in mm.

referenceRow.description: The row a design that names none is made at, such as {"Size": "M"}; null for none, when such a design reads each placement's own print area. Required when the print areas start to change with an option on a blank that has designs or designer links, which keep their size at it.

resolved.description: Each inheritable field resolved, with where it comes from: the printshop and machine, and every placement's and photo's printing fields and preview looks, in the order of `placements`.

source.description: Where the value comes from: the field's own, its blank category's, the workspace's default, or none (nothing sets it, and the built-in default applies).

printedAs.description: Printed as: the name the blank's printshop knows the placement by, on orders and job sheets. The placement's own shopName, else its name.

printedAsLinked.description: Whether Printed as follows the placement's name: true while it has no shopName of its own.

source.description: Where the value comes from: the field's own, its blank category's, the workspace's default, or none (nothing sets it, and the built-in default applies).

sharedViewPhoto.description: The first photo of the blank's first view of several placements that has one, in their order: the view, the photo (a mockup), its asset and the view's photo size. A blank whose views of one placement have no photo is pictured by it. Null for a blank with no such photo. Answered in a list.

status.description: `importing` while the blank's import, from a printshop's catalogue or a CSV file, runs in the background: it has its name and nothing else yet. `generating` for a blank generated with AI until its photo is approved: `generation` says whether it is drawing, waits for the decision, or drew nothing. `failed` when an import failed for good (`importFailure` says why); remove it and import again. `ready` otherwise.

stockItemKey.description: The stock item the blank's scenes photograph; null for none.

thumbnailUrl.description: A link to the blank's picture, opening with no key for an hour or two, so a list shows a picture of each blank: its first photo of a view of one placement, else `sharedViewPhoto`. Null for a blank with no photo. Answered in a list.

variantCount.description: How many variants the blank has, deleted ones included. Answered in a list.

variants.description: The blank's variants, retired ones included, with their printshop fields. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

attempts.description: How many times it was taken to run, the current or last run included; a wait gives its run back. For a schedule, the runs that failed since the last that succeeded.

kind.description: What the job does, such as `print.render`.

lastError.description: What it last failed with, as a code.

parkReason.description: Why a queued job waits: `continue`, it has more to do; `rate_limited`, the partner it asks refused it over its limit.

runAt.description: When a queued job runs next (epoch ms).

subjectId.description: The id of what the job works on, such as the print it renders.

axes.description: The blank's option axes, such as Color and Size, in the order the shopper sees them. Empty for a blank with one variant.

colours.description: One `#rrggbb` colour, or two for a heather or two-tone, drawn half and half.

tone.description: Whether a product in this value is light or dark, set by you. Absent, a colour fill's first colour decides (darker than mid grey is dark) and any other value is light. A template layer's on-dark value is used on a dark one.

oneOf.description: The value is drawn as a picture of it, such as a pattern.

assetId.description: An image in the workspace's asset library.

tone.description: Whether a product in this value is light or dark, set by you. Absent, a colour fill's first colour decides (darker than mid grey is dark) and any other value is light. A template layer's on-dark value is used on a dark one.

appearances.description: How each value looks to a shopper, by value: a colour fill, an image, or null for none. Every value of `values` is named.

localizedNames.description: The option's name per customer-facing language, by code: only the languages it has one in. A language left out reads `name`.

localizedValues.description: Each value's name per customer-facing language, by value: only the values that have one. A language left out reads the value itself.

tones.description: Whether a product in each value is light or dark, by value: the tone set on its appearance, else its colour fill's, else light. Every value of `values` is named. On a variant of a dark value a template's on-dark values are used.

optionsConfirmedAt.description: When the blank's options were confirmed: the merchant said it has one version, or added its first option. Null until then. A blank imported from a printshop's catalogue arrives confirmed.

order.description: The blank's stored views and the scenes it shows as one ordered list, each saying its source: `stock` (a scene), `catalogue` (the printshop's photos) or `own` (the merchant's). The first with a photo is the blank's picture. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

source.description: `catalogue` for the printshop's photos, `own` for the merchant's.

row.description: The option values the stock photo shows, by option name, of the options the blank's photos change with (`photosVaryBy`): shoppers see it only for the variants with these values. Absent or empty: every variant.

source.description: A scene from the library.

orderCount.description: How many orders name the blank, past ones included. Answered in a list, never for one blank, and only to a caller with `orders:read`.

paintBy.description: The option the blank's dyed photos are painted in, such as Colour: a stock photo that takes a dye, or a view drawn from a 3D render, shows each variant in its value's colour. null: the merchant's own photos show as photographed, while a stock photo that takes a dye is painted in the first option with colours.

photoCoverage.description: How much of the blank is photographed. Answered in a list.

cells.description: The blank's rows (each combination of the values of the options its photos change with; one for All) times its views.

filled.description: The cells with a photo, of their own row or a covering one.

photosVaryBy.description: The options the blank's photos change with, in option order: each photo belongs to one row, its values of these, and shows every variant with them. Empty is All: one photo per view shows every variant.

placements.description: The blank's placements: the areas a design is printed into. An update replaces the whole list, so send every placement to keep.

areas.description: The placement's print area per row of the blank's `areasVaryBy` options, such as one per size; omitted or empty, the placement has one print area, its own. maxWidthMm and maxHeightMm are then the widest and tallest row.

bleedMm.description: Bleed past the trim on the row, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, the placement's.

dpi.description: Print resolution on the row in dots per inch. Omitted, the placement's.

foldMm.description: How far in from the trim the product folds on the row, in millimetres. Omitted, the placement's.

heightMm.description: The tallest print the row takes, in millimetres.

row.description: The row: a value for each `areasVaryBy` option, by option name. One area per row per placement.

safeAreaMm.description: Safe area inside the trim on the row, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, the placement's.

shape.description: Where on the product a print may go on the row, such as one phone model's camera opening: as the placement's `shape`, in fractions of the row's print area. Omitted, the placement's.

cutByPrintShop.description: True when the print shop cuts the product to this shape: the outline and the cut-outs go into the print file as its cut line. Omitted, the product already has the shape.

dFrac.description: The shape as SVG path data in fractions of the print area, 0 to 1 across and down (curves, no arcs): its first subpath the outline, every further one a cut-out, filled even-odd, each subpath closed.

usualHeightMm.description: The height a print gets on the row when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most heightMm.

usualWidthMm.description: The width a print gets on the row when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most widthMm.

widthMm.description: The widest print the row takes, in millimetres.

bleedMm.description: Bleed past the trim on each side, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, its category's, else the workspace's.

coverage.description: How a print covers the placement: `within`, a print of any size up to the maximum placed inside it, or `full`, a print that is the whole area, such as an all-over-print panel. Omitted, `within`. A `full` placement's usual size is its area, and a request naming a smaller size is refused `print_size_not_area`.

defaultHeightMm.description: The height a print gets when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most maxHeightMm.

defaultWidthMm.description: The width a print gets when none is chosen, in millimetres, at most maxWidthMm.

dpi.description: Print resolution in dots per inch. Omitted, its category's, else 300.

fillColour.description: The `#rrggbb` colour an optional placement left undesigned is printed or delivered as. Null or omitted for none.

flatLayout.description: How the product is printed flat on one sheet and folded into shape, such as a folding box. Its print area is the sheet, printed edge to edge (`coverage` `full`) at one size. Null or omitted, the placement is printed as it lies.

parts.description: The sheet's parts, each a rectangle in mm from the sheet's top-left. The sheet is their span; a fold is where two parts share an edge, and the cut line is every other edge.

printed.description: True for a panel, named for the face of the folded product it becomes; false for a glue tab, hidden once folded. The print covers glue tabs too.

up.description: Which way is up on the part once folded, in quarter turns clockwise from the sheet's up: 2 for a flap that lies upside down on the sheet.

xMm.description: The part's left edge, in mm from the sheet's left.

yMm.description: The part's top edge, in mm from the sheet's top.

foldMm.description: How far in from the trim the product folds on every side, in millimetres, such as a canvas's wrap round its frame; the designer draws fold lines there. Omitted, no fold.

garments.description: Where the placement sits on each stock item the blank's scenes show, one record per item: the item, a garment area of it, and the print's top left and width on it in millimetres. A scene whose item has no record draws nothing of the placement. Refused `placement_garment_area_unknown` for an unknown item or area, `placement_garment_outside_area` past the area.

area.description: The key of a garment area of the record's stock item.

stockItem.description: The stock item the record is on, by its key.

widthMm.description: The print's width on the product, in mm. Its height follows from the placement's print area ratio.

xMm.description: The print's left edge, in mm from the area's left.

yMm.description: The print's top edge, in mm from the area's top.

id.description: Unique within the blank; a short stable one such as `front`, which a template refers to it by.

linkWith.description: The placement it is linked with by default, such as a right sleeve with the left one: one design then drives both unless a designer link, an SDK mount or a design says otherwise. Null or omitted for none. A placement linked with one no longer on the blank is linked with none.

mirror.description: Whether this placement's print is mirrored left to right when the two are linked.

placementId.description: The id of the blank's other placement it is linked with by default.

maxHeightMm.description: The tallest print the placement takes, in millimetres.

maxWidthMm.description: The widest print the placement takes, in millimetres.

name.description: What it is called, such as Front or Back.

printMethod.description: How this placement is printed, such as dtg or screen. Omitted, its category's.

required.description: Whether an order on the blank must print it: one without a print for it is refused `placement_unfilled`. Omitted is false; a blank bound to its printshop's product takes it from the printshop.

safeAreaMm.description: Safe area inside the trim on each side, in millimetres, 0 to 50. Omitted, its category's, else the workspace's.

shape.description: Where on the product a print may go when that is not the whole rectangle: nothing is printed outside the outline or in a cut-out. Null or omitted, the whole rectangle.

cutByPrintShop.description: True when the print shop cuts the product to this shape: the outline and the cut-outs go into the print file as its cut line. Omitted, the product already has the shape.

dFrac.description: The shape as SVG path data in fractions of the print area, 0 to 1 across and down (curves, no arcs): its first subpath the outline, every further one a cut-out, filled even-odd, each subpath closed.

shopName.description: Printed as: the name the blank's printshop knows the placement by, on orders and job sheets. Null or omitted prints the placement's name.

views.description: The ways the placement is photographed, such as Flat or On model. Every photo of one view shares its pixel size and its print area.

fromPrintshop.description: True on a view a blank bound to its printshop's product took from the printshop (its import, Add colours, model photos): its photo size and print area are the printshop's and cannot change by hand. Absent on a view the workspace added; a save that sends it is ignored.

label.description: What it is called, such as Flat or On model; unique among its placement's views of its kind, the printshop's or the merchant's, ignoring case.

localizedLabels.description: What it is called per customer-facing language, by code; a language left out reads `label`. No two views of its placement and kind read the same in one language, ignoring case.

maskAssetId.description: A library asset of the view's photo size: where it is light the print shows, where it is dark the print is hidden, as behind a sleeve or a fold. Absent hides nothing.

mesh.description: Control points the print is laid through or, marked cut, cut to, rows from its top edge and points from its left, as [x, y] in the photo's original pixels; at least 2 and at most 33 along each side. Absent, the print is laid in the rect.

cut.description: The points draw a shape to cut the print to rather than a mesh to bend it through: the print is laid flat over the box the points span, at its own proportions and filling it, and everything outside the shape the outer points draw is cut away. Absent, the print is warped through the mesh.

points.description: The rows of control points, from the print's top edge.

items.description: One row of control points, from the print's left edge.
One control point, [x, y] in the photo's original pixels.

partnerStyleKey.description: The printshop's own key for the photo style the view was made from, such as a model or lifestyle style; absent on a view made by hand or imported with the product.

photoSizePx.description: The pixel size every photo of the view has; null until the view holds a photo.

photos.description: The view's product photos, each the same size as the view.

assetId.description: The photo's asset id, as the assets feature returns it after an upload.

displacementStrength.description: How far the photo's folds move the design, more than 0 and at most 1. null moves nothing. Omitted, its category's, else nothing.

id.description: The photo's id, unique within the blank: the `mockupId` a render and a mockup link name.

row.description: The photo's value of each `photosVaryBy` option; empty when there are none. One photo per row per view.

shadingStrength.description: How strongly the photo's light and shade carry onto the design, 0 (none) to 1 (all). Omitted, its category's, else the default strength.

textureStrength.description: How strongly the photo's fine detail, such as a weave or a grain, shows through the print, 0 (none) to 1 (all). Omitted, its category's, else, as for null, the default strength.

variantRefs.description: The variants the photo shows, from its `row`. A write may name the row by these instead.

warp.description: How the design wraps round the product. null lies it flat. Omitted, its category's, else flat.

curvature.description: How far round the product the design wraps, more than 0 and at most 1. Flat is a null warp, not 0.

edgeFalloff.description: How much the design darkens toward the product's sides, 0 (none) to 1 (black at the edge). Omitted, none.

kind.description: The kind of wrap; `cylinder` is the only one.

piece.description: A pattern piece of the view's UV pass, 1 to 254: the region's print is read through the pixels the pass marks with it, in place of a mesh.

placementRectPx.description: Where the print area sits on every photo of the view, in the original photo's pixels; null until it is marked.

h.description: The print area's height, in pixels.

w.description: The print area's width, in pixels.

x.description: The print area's left edge, in pixels from the photo's left.

y.description: The print area's top edge, in pixels from the photo's top.

position.description: The view's place in the blank's one list of views and scenes, from 0. The first with a photo is the blank's picture. Read only.

printWindowMm.description: The part of the region's piece its print covers, in millimetres on the piece's unwrapped surface from its top-left corner, such as a square on the side of a cup: the print fills it at the window's size, and the product shows plain outside it. It lies inside its piece and needs the piece's size on the view. Absent, the whole piece.

xMm.description: The window's left edge, in mm from the piece's left.

yMm.description: The window's top edge, in mm from the piece's top.

sceneId.description: The scene this view shows. A scene's view is built from the blank's chosen scenes and is read only.

scenePosition.description: On a scene's view, its `position`, for a reader that orders scenes by it.

source.description: Where the view's photos come from: `stock` (a scene from the library), `catalogue` (the printshop's) or `own` (the merchant's). Read only.

sourceWindowMm.description: The piece of the placement's print the region shows, in millimetres from the print's top-left corner, such as a roll's window; clamped to the print when the print is smaller. Absent, the region shows the whole print at the size of the render's variant.

xMm.description: The window's left edge, in mm from the print's left.

yMm.description: The window's top edge, in mm from the print's top.

takesDye.description: On a scene's view, whether a variant's colour recolours it. One that takes none shows only the variants of its colour.

uvPasses.description: The maps the view was rendered with from a 3D model of the product, each the view's photo size; a region naming a piece is drawn through them. Absent, the view's regions are laid in their rect or mesh.

multiplyAssetId.description: The multiply pass: the garment's shadows and folds.

occluderAssetId.description: What lies in front of the print, drawn over it: hands, cords and hair. A scene's alone, and read only.

pieceSizesMm.description: Each piece's print size on the model, as its `view.json` gives it: what a region's print window is placed on. Absent, no region of the view may name a print window.

items.description: A piece of the UV pass and its print's size on the model.

heightMm.description: The piece's print height on the model, in mm.

piece.description: A pattern piece of the view's UV pass, 1 to 254: the region's print is read through the pixels the pass marks with it, in place of a mesh.

widthMm.description: The piece's print width on the model, in mm.

pieces.description: The pieces the UV pass marks, as its `view.json` lists them.

items.description: A pattern piece of the view's UV pass, 1 to 254: the region's print is read through the pixels the pass marks with it, in place of a mesh.

screenAssetId.description: The screen pass: the garment's highlights.

uvAssetId.description: The 16-bit UV pass: for each pixel, its piece (blue) and where across (red) and down (green) that piece's print it reads.

webPhotoAssetId.description: On a scene's view, the photo a browser shows: the lighter file of the same picture.

zoomTier.description: On a scene's view read at its preview tier, its files at the zoom tier.

maskAssetId.description: The file saying where on the picture a print may show.

multiplyAssetId.description: The shading laid over the print, darkening it.

occluderAssetId.description: What lies in front of the print, on a scene that has it.

photoAssetId.description: The scene's picture at this tier.

photoSizePx.description: How many pixels the scene's picture holds at this tier.

heightPx.description: The picture's height at this tier, in pixels.

widthPx.description: The picture's width at this tier, in pixels.

screenAssetId.description: The highlights laid over the print, lightening it.

uvAssetId.description: The file saying where each pixel lands on the print.

placementsAtOtherSize.description: The placements printed as a position that prints one size only at the blank's printshop whose default print size is another size: flagged, never refused, since an order of the position's size is still taken. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

position.description: The printshop's position the placement is printed as.

sizeMm.description: The one size that position prints, in mm.

referenceRow.description: The row a design that names none is made at, such as {"Size": "M"}; null for none, when such a design reads each placement's own print area. Required when the print areas start to change with an option on a blank that has designs or designer links, which keep their size at it.

resolved.description: Each inheritable field resolved, with where it comes from: the printshop and machine, and every placement's and photo's printing fields and preview looks, in the order of `placements`.

source.description: Where the value comes from: the field's own, its blank category's, the workspace's default, or none (nothing sets it, and the built-in default applies).

mockups.description: The placement's photos, every view's in view order.

curvature.description: How far round the product the design wraps, more than 0 and at most 1. Flat is a null warp, not 0.

edgeFalloff.description: How much the design darkens toward the product's sides, 0 (none) to 1 (black at the edge). Omitted, none.

kind.description: The kind of wrap; `cylinder` is the only one.

source.description: Where the value comes from: the field's own, its blank category's, the workspace's default, or none (nothing sets it, and the built-in default applies).

printedAs.description: Printed as: the name the blank's printshop knows the placement by, on orders and job sheets. The placement's own shopName, else its name.

printedAsLinked.description: Whether Printed as follows the placement's name: true while it has no shopName of its own.

source.description: Where the value comes from: the field's own, its blank category's, the workspace's default, or none (nothing sets it, and the built-in default applies).

sharedViewPhoto.description: The first photo of the blank's first view of several placements that has one, in their order: the view, the photo (a mockup), its asset and the view's photo size. A blank whose views of one placement have no photo is pictured by it. Null for a blank with no such photo. Answered in a list.

status.description: `importing` while the blank's import, from a printshop's catalogue or a CSV file, runs in the background: it has its name and nothing else yet. `generating` for a blank generated with AI until its photo is approved: `generation` says whether it is drawing, waits for the decision, or drew nothing. `failed` when an import failed for good (`importFailure` says why); remove it and import again. `ready` otherwise.

stockItemKey.description: The stock item the blank's scenes photograph; null for none.

thumbnailUrl.description: A link to the blank's picture, opening with no key for an hour or two, so a list shows a picture of each blank: its first photo of a view of one placement, else `sharedViewPhoto`. Null for a blank with no photo. Answered in a list.

variantCount.description: How many variants the blank has, deleted ones included. Answered in a list.

variants.description: The blank's variants, retired ones included, with their printshop fields. Answered for one blank, never in a list.

attempts.description: How many times it was taken to run, the current or last run included; a wait gives its run back. For a schedule, the runs that failed since the last that succeeded.

kind.description: What the job does, such as `print.render`.

lastError.description: What it last failed with, as a code.

parkReason.description: Why a queued job waits: `continue`, it has more to do; `rate_limited`, the partner it asks refused it over its limit.

runAt.description: When a queued job runs next (epoch ms).

subjectId.description: The id of what the job works on, such as the print it renders.

202.description: The blank, importing, and the job filling it in

feature.description: The feature the tenant does not have. Always sent with `feature_disabled`.

422.description: Refused: no_printable_placement, no_printshop_photos, stock_item_not_found, scene_not_found, scene_retired, stock_item_covers_no_placement, payload_too_large

500.description: Refused: lookup_failed, db_error. A request that failed unexpectedly answers as text instead.

post.summary: Import a catalogue product as a blank

value.description: Whether its printshop has a catalogue to browse and import from (GET /v1/printshop-catalogue-products).

post.description: A published template's id was changed. `<oldId>@<version>` goes on reading the template under its new id, so a stored reference keeps working whether or not this arrives; new references use `newId`, and a store that receives it moves the ones it holds.

parameters.description: When this attempt was sent, in Unix seconds.
parameters.name: x-pixonaut-timestamp

schema.description: When this attempt was sent, in Unix seconds.

parameters.description: `v1=` followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the endpoint's signing secret, of the `x-pixonaut-timestamp` value, a `.`, and the raw request body.

schema.description: `v1=` followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the endpoint's signing secret, of the `x-pixonaut-timestamp` value, a `.`, and the raw request body.

value.description: The images the workspace put in the template that print below their recommended resolution at the size. Empty when every image is at or above it, when the image was accepted as it is, or when the workspace turned these warnings off.

effectiveDpi.description: Pixels per inch along the edge that decides, at the size.

layerId.description: The layer the image fills, or the artwork's own key for its image background.

recommendedDpi.description: The resolution it is judged against: the template's minimum, else the workspace's.
